pages.observed: Five samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of option a. Empty generic restaurant room with open glass door at left, host stand with phone and hanging bag at right, river landscape through window. Caption appears at 0.6 s about the only server walking out. Door opens wider at 0.8 s. No human figure shown.

Option a 6.0 to 6.8 s. Same wide room held: woman with menu keeps arm raised for service, man seated at left table, ringing phone at frame edge. Caption who was going to take the order? Figures are small within the frame.

Option a 8.0 to 8.8 s. Front of house held: blank white sign frame swings slightly on its hanger, dark panel on stand unlit, host stand with phone and hanging bag. Caption The family didn't post a job ad.

Option a 12.0 to 12.8 s. Static close hold on the lit panel reading Haniya with ring icon and two bars. Caption They put an AI host named Haniya at the front of the house. No AI host tag yet; no change between samples.

Option a 19.0 to 19.8 s. Cut at 19.2 s to a close phone menu held in one hand; a second hand's index finger reaches in and touches the Chow mein row, which lights yellow at 19.8 s. Talk mic button and Pay button visible. Caption taps or talks to order,
